response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average ratio is the mean of per-line-item ratios (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost), not the ratio of summed totals to summed costs.
Ties in line item count at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tiebreaker.
Line items with a zero derived_product_cost would cause a division error in some databases; none are assumed to exist. NULL costs are ignored by AVG but still counted as line items.
